stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Druig defies Ikaris during the fall of Tenochtitlan, using his mind control to end the fighting despite Ikaris's order to stop, and then leaves the Eternals. Centuries later, when Druig's power becomes the key to halting the Emergence, Ikaris turns on the team to stop him.
stages.whoA: Fellow Eternal whose orders he defies, and who later turns on the team.
stages.whoB: Fellow Eternal who defies his orders and leaves. Ikaris later turns on him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Druig briefly takes control of Karun Patel's mind when the Eternals visit his compound in the Amazon.
stages.whoA: Kingo's valet, whose mind he briefly takes over in the Amazon.
stages.whoB: Eternal who briefly takes control of his mind at the Amazon compound.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kro leads a pack of Deviants against Druig's compound in the Amazon.
stages.whoA: Deviant leader who attacks his compound in the Amazon.
stages.whoB: Eternal whose Amazon compound he attacks with a pack of Deviants.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Makkari and Druig have feelings for each other. They reunite after centuries, and in the end they leave Earth together on the Domo.
stages.whoA: The Eternal he loves. They reunite after centuries and leave Earth together.
stages.whoB: The Eternal she loves. They reunite after centuries and leave Earth together.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi seeks out Druig at his compound in the Amazon and asks him to help stop the Emergence. He agrees to use his powers to put the Eternals to sleep if needed.
stages.whoA: Fellow Eternal who seeks him out to help stop the Emergence. He agrees.
stages.whoB: Fellow Eternal she recruits to help stop the Emergence.

stages.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
stages.text: Dum Dum Dugan knows Howard Stark from the war against HYDRA. In 1946 he lounges by the pool with Howard while Howard calls the SSR to name Peggy Carter head of the new S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Friend from the war against HYDRA. They lounge by the pool in 1946.
stages.whoB: Friend from the war against HYDRA. They lounge by the pool in 1946.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dum Dum Dugan fights alongside Peggy Carter in the war against HYDRA, and the two become close friends.
stages.whoA: Close friend who fights alongside him in the war against HYDRA.
stages.whoB: Howling Commando and close friend who fights alongside her against HYDRA.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After the war, Dugan and the Howling Commandos join Peggy on the SSR's mission into Russia, and they stay close friends.
stages.whoA: Close friend. He joins her SSR mission into Russia after the war.
stages.whoB: Close friend. He and the Howling Commandos join her mission into Russia.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dum Dum Dugan is one of the prisoners Steve Rogers frees from HYDRA, and he signs on to Steve's Howling Commandos. He fights at Steve's side against HYDRA until Steve goes into the ice.
stages.whoA: His commander. Steve frees him from HYDRA and leads the Howling Commandos.
stages.whoB: Howling Commando he frees from HYDRA, who fights at his side.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Dum-E and U are E.D.I.T.H.'s friends. Like her, they are Tony Stark's creations and end up inside White Vision's mind.
stages.whoA: Their friend, a fellow Stark creation inside White Vision's mind.
stages.whoB: Her friends, fellow Stark creations who end up inside White Vision's mind.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Tony Stark builds the robot arms Dum-E and U to help in his workshop, and he constantly scolds them. Dum-E saves Tony's life by handing him his old arc reactor after Obadiah Stane rips out the new one.
stages.whoA: Their creator. He builds them for his workshop and constantly scolds them.
stages.whoB: His workshop robots. Dum-E saves his life with the old arc reactor.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. is E.D.I.T.H.'s best friend. Both are Tony Stark's A.I.s and both end up inside White Vision's mind.
stages.whoA: Her best friend, a fellow Stark A.I. inside White Vision's mind.
stages.whoB: Her best friend, a fellow Stark A.I. inside White Vision's mind.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. and J.A.R.V.I.S. are A.I.s built by Tony Stark who both end up living inside White Vision's mind.
stages.whoA: Fellow Stark A.I. who also lives inside White Vision's mind.
stages.whoB: Fellow Stark A.I. who also lives inside White Vision's mind.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck tricks Peter into handing over E.D.I.T.H., then commands her drones to power his illusions and attack London. A stray shot from one of those drones ends up killing him.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, who tricks Peter into handing her over and commands her drones.
stages.whoB: Stark A.I. he tricks Peter into handing over. A stray drone shot kills him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. is the AI in the glasses Tony Stark leaves to Peter, giving him command of Stark's satellites and drone arsenal. Peter hands her over to Quentin Beck by mistake and has to fight her drones before he wins back control.
stages.whoA: Her new owner, from Tony. He loses her to Beck, then wins her back.
stages.whoB: Tony's A.I. in his glasses. He hands her to Beck, then wins her back.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Tony Stark builds the A.I. E.D.I.T.H. into a pair of sunglasses and leaves them to Peter Parker after his death, giving Peter control of Stark Industries' satellite and drone network.
stages.whoA: Her creator, who builds her into sunglasses and leaves her to Peter.
stages.whoB: His A.I., built into sunglasses he leaves to Peter after his death.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron and E.D.I.T.H. are both held inside White Vision's mind. They work together to hunt the killer synthezoid Jocasta.
stages.whoA: Fellow A.I. in White Vision's mind. They hunt Jocasta together.
stages.whoB: Fellow A.I. in White Vision's mind. They hunt Jocasta together.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. lives in White Vision's mind in the human form of Edith Marks. She becomes his close friend and helps him learn about humanity.
stages.whoA: White Vision, her host and close friend. She helps him learn about humanity.
stages.whoB: Close friend living in his mind as Edith Marks, teaching him about humanity.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Jorani, the Iron Fist, tackles the War Dog Ebo off his vehicle while hunting for a stolen artifact, before they end up on the same side.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist, who tackles him off his vehicle before they team up.
stages.whoB: War Dog she tackles off his vehicle, before they end up allies.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw and Gamora are both adopted children of Thanos. He is there when Thanos takes Gamora from Zen-Whoberi, and she despises him.
stages.whoA: Adoptive sister who despises him. He was there when Thanos took her.
stages.whoB: Adoptive brother she despises, there when Thanos takes her from Zen-Whoberi.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw and Nebula are both adopted children of Thanos. Nebula despises Maw, who is the one sibling who never fails their father.
stages.whoA: Adoptive sister who despises him.
stages.whoB: Adoptive brother she despises, the one sibling who never fails Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Ebony Maw abducts Doctor Strange in New York, Peter Parker chases him onto his ship as it leaves Earth. On the way to Titan, Peter and Tony Stark blow a hole in the hull and Maw is sucked out into space.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stows away on his ship and helps blow him into space.
stages.whoB: Black Order sorcerer he chases onto a ship and helps blow into space.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw and Proxima Midnight are adopted siblings raised by Thanos in the Black Order. They stand together on the Statesman as Thanos takes the Space Stone, then split up to hunt the Time Stone and the Mind Stone.
stages.whoA: Adoptive sister in the Black Order. They hunt Stones for Thanos.
stages.whoB: Adoptive brother in the Black Order. They hunt Stones for Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw kidnaps Stephen Strange and tortures him for the Time Stone.
stages.whoA: Sorcerer he kidnaps and tortures for the Time Stone.
stages.whoB: Black Order sorcerer who kidnaps and tortures him for the Time Stone.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw is one of the orphans Thanos takes from a conquered world and raises as his own child in the Black Order. He is his father's most devoted herald, preaching Thanos' mercy to the people he slaughters and hunting the Time Stone for him in New York.
stages.whoA: His adoptive father, whom he serves as his most devoted herald.
stages.whoB: Adopted son and most devoted herald, who hunts the Time Stone for him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw boards the Statesman with Thanos and helps slaughter the fleeing Asgardians. When Thor swears revenge for Loki's death, Maw pins him in twisted metal and gags him to keep him quiet.
stages.whoA: Asgardian he gags and pins in twisted metal on the Statesman.
stages.whoB: Black Order member who slaughters Asgardians and gags him on the Statesman.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Ebony Maw abducts Stephen Strange in New York, and Tony Stark follows him onto his ship. Tony and Peter Parker blow a hole in the hull and send Maw out into space.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who follows him onto his ship and helps blow him into space.
stages.whoB: Black Order member who abducts Strange, until Tony and Peter blow him into space.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Wong battles Ebony Maw alongside Doctor Strange when the Black Order comes to Greenwich Village for the Time Stone. Maw carries Strange off anyway, and Wong stays behind to guard the Sanctum.
stages.whoA: Sorcerer who fights him in Greenwich Village alongside Strange.
stages.whoB: Black Order member he fights for the Time Stone. Maw takes Strange anyway.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Detective Eddy Costa works to bring down the serial killer Gregory Sallinger, who keeps slipping through the law's hands.
stages.whoA: Serial killer he works to bring down, who keeps slipping the law.
stages.whoB: Detective working to bring him down.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Detective Eddy Costa arrests Jessica during the IGH killings, but he comes to believe her. He sticks his neck out to work the case with her.
stages.whoA: Private investigator he arrests, then believes. He risks his neck working with her.
stages.whoB: Detective who arrests her, then believes her and works the case with her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Costa keeps working with Jessica to bring down Gregory Sallinger and later Trish. Over time he comes to trust her completely, and the two end up as friends.
stages.whoA: Friend. He trusts her completely as they bring down Sallinger and Trish.
stages.whoB: Friend. He comes to trust her completely as they take down Sallinger.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: When Kilgrave takes over the 15th Precinct, he forces Detective Eddy Costa to sit with a gun pressed to his own head while he talks to Jessica Jones.
stages.whoA: Mind controller who makes him hold a gun to his own head.
stages.whoB: Detective he forces to hold a gun to his own head.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Detective Eddy Costa arrests Trish when she shoves her way into Jessica's arrest. Once Trish becomes a killer vigilante, Costa works with Jessica to bring her in.
stages.whoA: Jessica's adoptive sister. He arrests her, then hunts her as a killer vigilante.
stages.whoB: Detective who arrests her, then works with Jessica to bring her in.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Edison Po is the Centipede Project's only line to the Clairvoyant, who is secretly John Garrett. Po helps capture and interrogate Phil Coulson for him, and the Clairvoyant then has him killed.
stages.whoA: The Clairvoyant, his secret boss, who has him killed.
stages.whoB: Centipede's line to him as the Clairvoyant, until he has Po killed.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Edison Po tortures Phil Coulson after Centipede captures him, trying to pry loose the secret of his resurrection for the Clairvoyant.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he tortures for the secret of his resurrection.
stages.whoB: Centipede man who tortures him over the secret of his resurrection.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina and Edison Po work together on the Centipede Project, and Raina gets him out of prison to help capture Phil Coulson. When she pushes for answers about the Clairvoyant, Po warns her that the last person who asked got a knife for it.
stages.whoA: Centipede partner who breaks him out of prison to capture Coulson.
stages.whoB: Centipede partner she frees from prison. He warns her off asking about the Clairvoyant.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Edwin Jarvis is Howard Stark's butler and best friend. Howard trusts him with everything, including helping Peggy Carter clear Howard's name.
stages.whoA: His employer and best friend, who trusts him with everything.
stages.whoB: His butler and best friend, trusted with everything.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jack Thompson interrogates Edwin Jarvis about Howard Stark's car and threatens to have his wife Ana deported, but Jarvis keeps lying to protect Howard. They end up on the same side when Jarvis volunteers to fly up and stop Howard's hypnotized flight over Manhattan.
stages.whoA: SSR agent who interrogates him and threatens Ana, before they end up allies.
stages.whoB: Howard's butler. He lies to protect Howard, then helps stop the hypnotized flight.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Joseph Manfredi is the mob boss who helps Whitney Frost kidnap Jason Wilkes, and he nearly kills Edwin Jarvis. Later he turns on Whitney and works with Jarvis and Peggy Carter to stop her.
stages.whoA: Mob boss who nearly kills him, then helps him stop Whitney Frost.
stages.whoB: Peggy's ally, whom he nearly kills, then works with against Whitney.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Edwin Jarvis disables Leet Brannis' milk truck full of Nitramene bombs so he cannot escape Peggy Carter. When the three leap from the truck before it goes into the water, Jarvis lands on Brannis, who dies soon after.
stages.whoA: Leviathan agent whose bomb truck he disables. He lands on Brannis, who dies.
stages.whoB: Stark's butler, who disables his bomb truck and lands on him in the escape.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Edwin Jarvis helps Peggy Carter on her secret missions to clear Howard Stark's name. Along the way they become close friends.
stages.whoA: Close friend he helps on secret missions to clear Howard's name.
stages.whoB: Close friend who helps her on secret missions to clear Howard's name.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley hauls Edwin Jarvis in over Howard Stark's car and later tails him to press him about the Battle of Finow, but the loyal butler gives nothing away. When Dooley is trapped in Leviathan's vest, Jarvis is the one who explains it is about to explode.
stages.whoA: SSR chief who presses him about Howard, then gets trapped in Leviathan's vest.
stages.whoB: Howard's loyal butler, who gives nothing away and explains the vest is a bomb.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rufus Hunt, the Arena Club's head of security, attacks Peggy Carter at Howard Stark's estate, and Edwin Jarvis fights him off. Jarvis later helps Peggy capture Hunt by posing as a police officer to flush him out of his house.
stages.whoA: Arena Club security chief he fights off, then helps capture.
stages.whoB: Stark's butler, who fights him off, then helps Peggy capture him.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Edwin Jarvis is the Stark family's butler who looks after a young Tony Stark, and Tony later names his AI after him. Traveling back to 1970, Tony crosses paths with a younger Jarvis at Camp Lehigh.
stages.whoA: The young Stark he looks after. Tony later names his A.I. after him.
stages.whoB: The family butler who looks after him as a boy. His A.I.'s namesake.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Edwin Jarvis poses as a studio boss to get close to Whitney Frost and becomes her enemy.
stages.whoA: Villain he gets close to by posing as a studio boss.
stages.whoB: Peggy's ally, who poses as a studio boss to get close to her.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gamora distrusts Ego from the moment he appears claiming to be Quill's father. With Nebula, she uncovers his plan to remake the universe and helps the Guardians destroy him.
stages.whoA: Guardian who distrusts him from the start and helps destroy him.
stages.whoB: Quill's father, whom she distrusts from the start, then helps destroy.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: During the battle on Ego's planet, Groot carries Rocket's bomb deep into Ego's core and plants it, destroying him.
stages.whoA: Baby Groot, who plants the bomb in his core that destroys him.
stages.whoB: Quill's father, a living planet. He plants the bomb in Ego's core.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ego hired Yondu's crew, Kraglin included, to bring him Peter Quill, and Kraglin and Yondu later agree it was for the best that they never did. When the Guardians fight Ego, Kraglin flies the ship that carries them off his dying planet.
stages.whoA: Ravager in the crew he hired to bring him Quill.
stages.whoB: Quill's father, who hired Yondu's crew. He flies the Guardians off his planet.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ego raises Mantis alone on his planet, using her empathic powers to help him sleep. She warns the Guardians of his plan and puts him to sleep so they can destroy him.
stages.whoA: Ward he raises alone to help him sleep, who helps the Guardians destroy him.
stages.whoB: The planet who raises her alone, using her to sleep. She helps destroy him.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Mantis reveals that Ego was her father too, which makes her Peter Quill's sister.
stages.whoA: His daughter, which makes her Peter Quill's sister.
stages.whoB: Her father, which makes Peter Quill her brother.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ego is Meredith Quill's former lover. He gave her the brain tumor that killed her.
stages.whoA: Former lover. He gave her the brain tumor that killed her.
stages.whoB: Former lover who gave her the brain tumor that killed her.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula and Gamora uncover the skeletons of Ego's children in the caves beneath his planet. Nebula then fights alongside the Guardians to destroy him.
stages.whoA: Gamora's sister, who finds his children's skeletons and helps destroy him.
stages.whoB: Quill's father. She finds his children's skeletons and helps destroy him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ego is Peter Quill's father, a living planet. When Peter learns that Ego caused his mother's death, he fights and destroys him.
stages.whoA: His son, who learns the truth about his mother and destroys him.
stages.whoB: His father, a living planet, who caused his mother's death.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Rocket is suspicious of Ego from the start. During the battle on Ego's planet, Rocket builds the bomb that Groot plants at Ego's core to destroy him.
stages.whoA: Guardian, suspicious from the start, who builds the bomb that destroys him.
stages.whoB: Quill's father, whom he distrusts, then destroys with his bomb.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Ego hires Yondu to kidnap his children from across the galaxy, including Peter Quill. Yondu keeps Peter instead of delivering him, and he dies helping Peter destroy Ego.
stages.whoA: Ravager he hires to bring him his children. Yondu keeps Peter instead.
stages.whoB: Client who hires him to fetch his children. He dies helping Peter destroy him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos forces Eitri to forge the Infinity Gauntlet, then kills the other dwarves of Nidavellir and destroys Eitri's hands.
stages.whoA: Titan who forces him to forge the Gauntlet, then destroys his hands.
stages.whoB: Dwarf king he forces to forge the Gauntlet, whose hands he destroys.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Eitri, king of the dwarves of Nidavellir, once forged Mjolnir for Odin. When Thor finds him alone in his dead forge, Eitri helps him make Stormbreaker.
stages.whoA: Odin's son, whom he helps forge Stormbreaker.
stages.whoB: Dwarf king who forged Mjolnir and helps him make Stormbreaker.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Elaine Walters is Jennifer's mother, who greets her with a kiss at the family dinner after she is fired. Elaine is in the audience at the gala when Intelligencia exposes Jennifer, and she takes her daughter back into the family home afterward.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, whom she takes back home after Intelligencia exposes her.
stages.whoB: Her mom, who takes her back home after Intelligencia exposes her.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Elaine and Morris Walters are Jennifer's parents and a married couple who face her troubles together, from the family dinner after she is fired to the gala where Intelligencia humiliates her. When reporters swarm their house after her release, Morris sprays them with a hose.
stages.whoA: Her husband, and Jennifer's dad.
stages.whoB: His wife, and Jennifer's mom.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Skaar is the son of Elaine's nephew Bruce Banner, making her his great-aunt.
stages.whoA: Her great-nephew, the son of her nephew Bruce Banner.
stages.whoB: His great-aunt, the aunt of his father Bruce Banner.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Jack Duquesne is engaged to Eleanor Bishop until she frames him for murder to hide her own crimes.
stages.whoA: Her fiancé, whom she frames for murder to hide her crimes.
stages.whoB: His fiancée, who frames him for murder to hide her own crimes.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Eleanor Bishop is Kate Bishop's mother. Kate turns her in after learning she has been working with Wilson Fisk.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, who turns her in for working with Fisk.
stages.whoB: Her mother. Kate turns her in for working with Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: When Eleanor Bishop tries to cut her ties with Wilson Fisk, Fisk orders Kazi of the Tracksuit Mafia to kill her. Her daughter Kate saves her before he can.
stages.whoA: Sent by Fisk to kill her. Kate saves her first.
stages.whoB: Kate's mother, whom Fisk orders him to kill.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Eleanor Bishop secretly pays Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, who passes the job to Yelena Belova and sends her after Clint Barton.
stages.whoA: The broker she pays to send Yelena after Clint.
stages.whoB: Client who pays her for the hit on Clint.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: After her husband Derek dies owing Wilson Fisk, Eleanor Bishop starts working with Fisk and hides it from her daughter Kate. When she decides to break away and threatens him with evidence she has stashed, he tries to have her killed.
stages.whoA: Her husband's creditor and secret partner, who tries to have her killed.
stages.whoB: Secret partner, Derek's widow, who tries to break away. He orders her killed.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Eleanor Bishop secretly pays for Yelena Belova to be sent after Clint Barton.
stages.whoA: The assassin she pays for, sent after Clint Barton.
stages.whoB: Kate's mother, who paid for the hit on Clint.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: After Elektra is resurrected as the Black Sky, she fights for the Hand alongside Madame Gao.
stages.whoA: Hand leader she fights alongside after her resurrection.
stages.whoB: The Black Sky, who fights for the Hand at her side.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Elektra Natchios is Matt's ex-girlfriend from college. She returns to pull him back into danger, and they fall for each other again before she dies in his arms.
stages.whoA: Ex-boyfriend from college. They fall again, and she dies in his arms.
stages.whoB: Ex from college who pulls him into danger and dies in his arms.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Elektra is resurrected as the Black Sky, the Hand's weapon, with no memory of Matt, and she fights him for the Hand. He keeps trying to reach the woman she was.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, a stranger to her now. She fights him for the Hand.
stages.whoB: The Black Sky now, with no memory of him. He tries to reach her.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: After Elektra kills Alexandra Reid and takes over the Hand, Murakami follows her as his new leader. They fight the Defenders together beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoA: Hand fighter who follows her as his new leader.
stages.whoB: His new leader after she kills Alexandra and takes over the Hand.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nobu of the Hand kills Elektra in a rooftop battle, and the Hand later steals her body.
stages.whoA: Hand assassin who kills her in a rooftop battle.
stages.whoB: Stick's warrior, whom he kills in a rooftop battle.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Sowande is charged with finding the Hand's Black Sky, and he collects Elektra's body after her death so she can be reborn. Once she is raised, he brings her into the Hand's work at Alexandra's side.
stages.whoA: Hand member who collects her body so she can be reborn.
stages.whoB: The Black Sky he finds and brings into the Hand's work.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Stick trains Elektra as a child to fight the Hand, raising her as his weapon.
stages.whoA: Her mentor, who trains her as a child to fight the Hand.
stages.whoB: His pupil, raised from childhood as his weapon against the Hand.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: After she is resurrected as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Stick.
stages.whoA: Her old mentor, whom she kills as the Black Sky.
stages.whoB: His old pupil, who kills him as the Black Sky.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Elena Cardenas is a client and friend of Foggy's at Nelson and Murdock. She pays them in baked goods.
stages.whoA: Lawyer and friend who defends her. She pays in baked goods.
stages.whoB: Client and friend who pays in baked goods.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Elena Cardenas is one of Karen's first clients at Nelson and Murdock, and the two become friends.
stages.whoA: Friend at Nelson and Murdock, one of the first to help her.
stages.whoB: One of her first clients, who becomes a friend.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Elena Cardenas is a tenant Matt and Foggy defend against Fisk's landlords. She becomes a dear friend until Fisk has her killed.
stages.whoA: Lawyer who defends her against Fisk's landlords, and a dear friend.
stages.whoB: Tenant he defends against Fisk, a dear friend until Fisk has her killed.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk wants Elena Cardenas out of her building and has her killed.
stages.whoA: Developer who wants her out of her building and has her killed.
stages.whoB: Tenant who won't leave her building. He has her killed.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Eli Morrow rigs a bomb at the Chinatown Crew headquarters that nearly kills Yo-Yo. In the final fight she uses a magnet to trap him in his own core as it is pulled through the portal.
stages.whoA: Villain whose bomb nearly kills her. She traps him in his own core.
stages.whoB: Yo-Yo, who survives his bomb and traps him in his own core.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch abducts Yo-Yo and the rest of the team from a diner and sends them into the future to save the Earth.
stages.whoA: Chronicom who abducts the team and sends them into the future.
stages.whoB: Agent he abducts and sends into the future to save the Earth.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Enoch travels with the team through time and becomes a trusted friend who fights alongside Yo-Yo against the Chronicom Hunters.
stages.whoA: Trusted friend who travels with the team and fights the Chronicom Hunters.
stages.whoB: Trusted friend he fights alongside against the Chronicom Hunters.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: In the future Lighthouse, Yo-Yo befriends Flint, a young Inhuman who is the only one in his ceremony to gain powers. During the revolt against Kasius she cuts out his metric implant, and she and Mack stay behind with him to help free the people.
stages.whoA: Young Inhuman she befriends in the future and stays behind to help.
stages.whoB: Friend from the future who cuts out his implant and stays to help.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Grill puts Yo-Yo to work in the Salvage in the future Lighthouse, where workers are zapped to keep them in line. She uses her speed to steal a Kree scroll from his office and frames his right-hand man Zev as the thief.
stages.whoA: Boss of the Salvage, from whose office she steals a Kree scroll.
stages.whoB: Salvage worker who steals a scroll from his office and frames Zev.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Yo-Yo loses both of her arms when the team walks into a trap set by General Hale's Hydra and Hale's daughter Ruby attacks her. Yo-Yo later kills Ruby, and Hale wants revenge for her daughter's death.
stages.whoA: Hydra general whose trap costs her her arms. Ruby's mother, who wants revenge.
stages.whoB: Agent who kills her daughter Ruby, after Ruby took her arms.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When Yo-Yo is shot by Primitives during the attack on the Playground, Holden Radcliffe, just freed from Hive's control, works to stop the bleeding and save her life.
stages.whoA: Scientist who saves her life after the Primitives shoot her.
stages.whoB: Inhuman he saves after the Primitives shoot her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Yo-Yo signs the Sokovia Accords with Director Jeffrey Mace, then goes behind his back to hunt down the man who killed her cousin. Mace warns her that the Accords require him to hand her over to Secretary Ross and the Raft.
stages.whoA: Her director, whose back she goes behind to avenge her cousin.
stages.whoB: Agent who signs the Accords with him, then goes rogue for revenge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Jemma Simmons studies Yo-Yo's speed when she first comes to S.H.I.E.L.D., and the two become friends.
stages.whoA: Friend who studies her speed when she first joins S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: Friend whose speed she studies when Yo-Yo first comes in.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: After Ruby Hale cuts off Yo-Yo's arms, Jemma looks after her through her recovery and is the one who fits her with new bionic arms.
stages.whoA: Friend who nurses her and fits her with new bionic arms.
stages.whoB: Friend she nurses after Ruby takes her arms, and fits with bionics.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Joey Gutierrez questions Yo-Yo in Spanish after the team catches her in Bogotá, and she explains she stole the guns so no one could use them. They go on to serve together in Daisy's Secret Warriors.
stages.whoA: Fellow Inhuman who questions her in Spanish, then a Secret Warriors teammate.
stages.whoB: Fellow Inhuman he questions in Spanish, then fights beside in the Secret Warriors.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: In 1983, a younger John Garrett who can teleport plants bombs to bring down the Lighthouse. Yo-Yo uses her speed to slap disruptor panels on him so he cannot teleport away.
stages.whoA: A younger, teleporting Garrett in 1983, whom she stops with disruptor panels.
stages.whoB: Speedster who slaps disruptors on him so he cannot teleport.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Elena Rodriguez rallies the people of the Lighthouse against Kasius. Facing him down, she calls him a cruel, sad, little blue man and tells him they should skip to the part where she ends this.
stages.whoA: Kree overlord of the Lighthouse she rallies the people against.
stages.whoB: Human who rallies the Lighthouse against him and calls him a sad blue man.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Yo-Yo helps Fitz track down the Watchdogs' blackout device, and Fitz, Coulson and Mack save her from a Watchdog execution.
stages.whoA: Friend she helps hunt the blackout device. He helps save her.
stages.whoB: Friend who helps him hunt the Watchdogs' device, and whom he helps rescue.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: After Yo-Yo loses her arms, Fitz builds her new ones. When Mack locks Fitz in a cell, she is the one who frees him.
stages.whoA: Friend who builds her new arms. She frees him from Mack's cell.
stages.whoB: Friend he builds new arms for, who frees him from his cell.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Yo-Yo and Lincoln Campbell fight side by side in Daisy's Secret Warriors, including the mission where they bring in Gideon Malick. When Coulson suspects one of them is under Hive's control, they both stand up to him.
stages.whoA: Secret Warriors teammate who fights beside her and stands up to Coulson.
stages.whoB: Secret Warriors teammate who fights beside him and stands up to Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Melinda May looks out for Yo-Yo after she joins Coulson's team.
stages.whoA: Friend who looks out for her on Coulson's team.
stages.whoB: Friend she looks out for after Yo-Yo joins the team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: In the year after Coulson's death, May urges Yo-Yo not to shut Mack out of her life. When the team lands in 1955, the two of them storm a lab at Area 51 to flush out a Chronicom spy.
stages.whoA: Friend who urges her not to shut Mack out. They storm Area 51.
stages.whoB: Friend she urges not to shut Mack out. They storm Area 51 together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Phil Coulson brings Yo-Yo into S.H.I.E.L.D., and he leads the rescue when a Watchdog squad is about to execute her.
stages.whoA: Friend who brings her into S.H.I.E.L.D. and rescues her from the Watchdogs.
stages.whoB: Friend he brings into S.H.I.E.L.D. and rescues from a Watchdog execution.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Yo-Yo learns from her future self that saving Coulson could doom the Earth, and Coulson himself heeds her warning.
stages.whoA: Friend whose rescue could doom Earth. He heeds her warning.
stages.whoB: Friend who warns him that saving him could doom the Earth.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Piper and Yo-Yo keep Zephyr One flying while the team is trapped in the Framework, arguing over whether to risk dropping the cloak to refuel.
stages.whoA: Friend she keeps Zephyr One flying with while the team is in the Framework.
stages.whoB: Friend who keeps Zephyr One flying with her while the team is trapped.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale slices off both of Yo-Yo's arms with her chakram during an ambush. Yo-Yo later kills Ruby with that same blade, both to avenge herself and to stop Ruby's Gravitonium rampage.
stages.whoA: Hydra fighter who slices off her arms. She kills Ruby with that blade.
stages.whoB: Agent whose arms she slices off, who kills her with the same blade.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, keeps coming back in robot bodies to fight S.H.I.E.L.D. and taunts Yo-Yo that he has died countless times while she gets no second chance. In their final duel she destroys him, and he loses his last life.
stages.whoA: Robot-bodied foe who taunts her about his lives. She destroys his last one.
stages.whoB: Agent he taunts with his many lives, who destroys his last one.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
stages.text: Colonel Victor Ramon murdered Elena Rodriguez's cousin in Colombia. She tracks him down for revenge.
stages.whoA: The colonel who murdered her cousin, whom she hunts for revenge.
stages.whoB: Cousin of a man he murdered, who hunts him for revenge.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Isaiah is Eli Bradley's grandfather. Eli lives with him in Baltimore and looks out for him.
stages.whoA: His grandfather, whom he lives with and looks out for.
stages.whoB: His grandson, who lives with him and looks out for him.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Eli Bradley is wary when Sam Wilson first comes to see his grandfather Isaiah. Sam later brings Eli and Isaiah to see Isaiah honored in the Captain America exhibit.
stages.whoA: Falcon he distrusts at first, who later gets Isaiah honored in the exhibit.
stages.whoB: Isaiah's grandson, wary at first, whom he brings to the exhibit.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Eli Morrow is Gabe Reyes's uncle, who raised the boys after their parents died.
stages.whoA: His nephew, whom he raised after his parents died.
stages.whoB: His uncle, who raised him and Robbie after their parents died.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Director Jeffrey Mace leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He reluctantly lets Ghost Rider help stop Morrow, insisting Robbie will answer for his crimes later.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who storms his Chinatown headquarters.
stages.whoB: Darkhold villain whose headquarters he storms.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Eli Morrow and Lucy Bauer were colleagues at Momentum Labs. He arranged the attack that left her a ghost, and she later takes him hostage.
stages.whoA: Former Momentum colleague he made a ghost, who takes him hostage.
stages.whoB: Former Momentum colleague who made her a ghost. She takes him hostage.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Phil Coulson visits Eli Morrow in prison to ask about his work at Momentum Labs and later tries to bring him to safety. Eli turns out to be using the Darkhold's knowledge to create matter, and Coulson's team stops him with Ghost Rider's help.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who visits him in prison, then stops his plan.
stages.whoB: Momentum scientist he questions in prison, who turns out to be the villain.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Eli Morrow is Robbie Reyes' uncle. When Eli seeks power through the Darkhold, Robbie, as Ghost Rider, drags him away to stop him.
stages.whoA: His nephew. As Ghost Rider, he drags him away.
stages.whoB: His uncle, who seeks power through the Darkhold until Robbie stops him.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Ellen Brandt and Eric Savin are Extremis agents who work as a team for Aldrich Killian. Sent to Rose Hill together, they ambush Tony Stark at a diner, and Brandt dies in the fight that follows.
stages.whoA: Extremis partner working for Killian. They ambush Tony at a diner.
stages.whoB: Extremis partner who ambushes Tony with him and dies in the fight.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Ellen Brandt, one of Aldrich Killian's Extremis soldiers, poses as a Homeland Security agent to capture Tony Stark in Rose Hill. Tony fights her off with improvised traps and kills her.
stages.whoA: Target she poses as Homeland Security to capture. He kills her with traps.
stages.whoB: Extremis soldier posing as Homeland Security, whom he kills in Rose Hill.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe passes Senator Ellen Nadeer information about S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Scientist who feeds her information about S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: Senator he passes S.H.I.E.L.D. secrets to.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Senator Ellen Nadeer debates Jeffrey Mace in public and fights his support for Inhumans.
stages.whoA: Pro Inhuman S.H.I.E.L.D. director she debates and fights in public.
stages.whoB: Anti Inhuman senator who debates him in public and fights his support.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Ellen Nadeer gets Jemma Simmons sent on a secret mission to help her brother through Terrigenesis.
stages.whoA: Agent she has sent on a secret mission to help her brother.
stages.whoB: Senator who sends her on a secret mission to help her brother.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: The Superior backs Senator Ellen Nadeer and orders her to kill her own brother after he becomes Inhuman.
stages.whoA: Her backer, who orders her to kill her own Inhuman brother.
stages.whoB: Senator he backs and orders to kill her Inhuman brother.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley kills Ellen Nadeer after she refuses to kill her Inhuman brother.
stages.whoA: Inhuman who kills her when she refuses to kill her brother.
stages.whoB: Senator he kills after she refuses to kill her brother.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jakob Nystrom's group steals part of the Berserker Staff from Elliot Randolph and stabs him.
stages.whoA: Thieves who steal part of the Berserker Staff and stab him.
stages.whoB: Asgardian professor they rob of the Berserker Staff and stab.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Jack Russell and Elsa Bloodstone team up during the hunt at Bloodstone Manor. She frees him and they part as friends.
stages.whoA: Fellow hunter she teams up with and frees. They part as friends.
stages.whoB: Fellow hunter who teams up with him and frees him. They part friends.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Elsa Bloodstone frees Ted, the Man-Thing, from his captivity at Bloodstone Manor.
stages.whoA: Man-Thing, whom she frees from captivity at Bloodstone Manor.
stages.whoB: Hunter who frees him from captivity at Bloodstone Manor.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Elsa Bloodstone competes against the other hunters for the Bloodstone and ends up their leader.
stages.whoA: Rival hunters she competes against for the Bloodstone, then leads.
stages.whoB: Rival hunter who competes for the Bloodstone and ends up their leader.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Verussa Bloodstone is Elsa's stepmother. They resent each other, and Verussa tries to kill Elsa before Elsa takes the Bloodstone.
stages.whoA: Her stepmother, who resents her and tries to kill her.
stages.whoB: Her stepdaughter, whom she resents and tries to kill.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jennifer represents Emil Blonsky at his parole hearing, and later visits his retreat where he counsels other super-powered people.
stages.whoA: His lawyer, who represents him at parole and visits his retreat.
stages.whoB: Client she represents at parole, who counsels people at his retreat.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Emil Blonsky storms Samuel Sterns' lab and forces him to inject him with Bruce Banner's blood, turning Blonsky into the Abomination. In the chaos, a drop of that blood falls into a wound on Sterns' head and starts his own transformation.
stages.whoA: Scientist he forces to inject him with Banner's blood.
stages.whoB: Soldier who forces him to inject Banner's blood and becomes the Abomination.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: General Thaddeus Ross recruits Emil Blonsky to hunt the Hulk and gives him an early super-soldier serum.
stages.whoA: General who recruits him to hunt the Hulk and gives him serum.
stages.whoB: Soldier he recruits to hunt the Hulk and doses with serum.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wong opens a portal to Emil Blonsky's prison cell and takes him to Macau for a staged cage match. Afterward he scolds Blonsky for fighting harder than they agreed and brings him back to his cell.
stages.whoA: Sorcerer who portals him to Macau for a staged cage fight.
stages.whoB: Prisoner he portals out for a staged fight, then scolds for going too hard.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong, now Blonsky's friend, owns up at the parole hearing to breaking him out for their fights. When Blonsky is locked up again, Wong frees him and takes him to Kamar-Taj.
stages.whoA: Friend who owns up to breaking him out, then frees him again.
stages.whoB: Friend he breaks out for fights, and later frees to Kamar-Taj.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Enoch saves Jemma and Fitz from the Chronicom Hunters and spends years hidden away with them working out how to travel through time. Together they build a Chronicom Life Model Decoy of Phil Coulson to guide the team through S.H.I.E.L.D.'s past.
stages.whoA: Friend he saves from the Hunters and hides with for years.
stages.whoB: Chronicom friend who saves her and Fitz, then hides with them for years.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch is a Chronicom who befriends Leo Fitz and helps him reach the team in the future.
stages.whoA: Human he befriends and helps reach the team in the future.
stages.whoB: Chronicom who befriends him and helps him reach the future.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Enoch becomes Fitz's best friend and stands by him for years while Fitz and Jemma hide from the Chronicoms.
stages.whoA: His best friend, whom he stands by for years in hiding.
stages.whoB: His best friend, who stands by him for years in hiding.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch, the Chronicom who sends the team into the future, rescues May on the surface of a ruined Earth in 2091.
stages.whoA: Agent he rescues on the ruined surface of Earth in 2091.
stages.whoB: Chronicom who sends the team forward and rescues her in 2091.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Enoch becomes a trusted friend who heals May's wounds from Sarge in a healing pod. He once draws an I.C.E.R. on her to stop her leaving Zephyr One against orders.
stages.whoA: Trusted friend he heals, and once stops with an I.C.E.R.
stages.whoB: Trusted friend who heals her, and once draws an I.C.E.R. on her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Enoch kidnaps Phil Coulson's team from a diner and sends them into the future to save the Earth.
stages.whoA: Director whose team he kidnaps and sends into the future.
stages.whoB: Chronicom who kidnaps his team and sends them into the future.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: After Coulson's death, Enoch helps Fitz and Jemma build a Chronicom Life Model Decoy of him. The two grow close on their trip through time.
stages.whoA: Friend he helps rebuild as an L.M.D. They grow close through time.
stages.whoB: Friend who helps build his L.M.D. body. They grow close through time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Piper flies with Enoch on the search for Fitz and sticks up for him when Davis gets fed up with his complaining.
stages.whoA: Pilot who flies with him to find Fitz and sticks up for him.
stages.whoB: Chronicom she flies with to find Fitz, and sticks up for.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Years later, Enoch, Fitz and Jemma trust Piper to guard the module that holds Fitz and Jemma's daughter.
stages.whoA: Agent he trusts to guard the module holding Fitz and Jemma's daughter.
stages.whoB: Chronicom who trusts her to guard Fitz and Jemma's daughter.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Eric Koenig puts Coulson's team through a lie detector at Providence, and Grant Ward's test shows signs that he is lying. Ward strangles Koenig with a garrote before his secret can come out.
stages.whoA: Agent who fails his lie detector test, then strangles him with a garrote.
stages.whoB: Providence agent whose lie test flags him. He strangles Koenig with a garrote.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury stations Eric Koenig at Providence, one of his secret bases, and trusts him with his biggest secrets, including that Fury is still alive. Koenig passes the news to Phil Coulson but warns him to keep it quiet.
stages.whoA: His boss, who trusts him with Providence and the secret he is alive.
stages.whoB: Agent he trusts to run Providence and keep his survival secret.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Eric Koenig welcomes Phil Coulson to Providence, tells him Fury is still alive, and threatens him if he reveals it to his team. Soon after, Grant Ward kills Koenig before he can help any further.
stages.whoA: Agent he welcomes to Providence and tells that Fury is alive.
stages.whoB: Providence agent who tells him Fury lives, before Ward kills him.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Happy Hogan tails Eric Savin to the TCL Chinese Theatre, where Savin's Extremis explosion leaves Happy badly hurt and in a coma.
stages.whoA: Stark's security chief, whom his Extremis blast puts in a coma.
stages.whoB: Extremis agent he tails, whose explosion puts him in a coma.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Eric Savin takes Harley Keener hostage in Rose Hill to force Tony Stark to hand over a file. Harley's quick thinking helps Tony take him down.
stages.whoA: Kid he takes hostage, whose quick thinking helps Tony stop him.
stages.whoB: Extremis agent who takes him hostage to pressure Tony.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Eric Savin takes James Rhodes' stolen Iron Patriot armor and uses it to snatch the President from Air Force One.
stages.whoA: Colonel whose Iron Patriot armor he steals to snatch the President.
stages.whoB: Extremis agent who steals his Iron Patriot armor to snatch the President.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Eric Savin attacks Tony Stark and later blows up Air Force One. Tony kills him.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who kills him after he blows up Air Force One.
stages.whoB: Extremis agent who blows up Air Force One, and whom he kills.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Martha Williams is Eric's mother, and she raises him and his younger brother Simon on her own after her husband Sanford dies.
stages.whoA: His mom, who raises him and Simon alone after their dad dies.
stages.whoB: Her older son, whom she raises alone after Sanford dies.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Eric Williams is Simon's older brother, and the two attend the same high school. They are raised by their mother Martha after their father dies.
stages.whoA: His younger brother, at the same high school.
stages.whoB: His older brother, at the same high school.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik Gelden senses the darkness in Gregory Sallinger and tries to blackmail him, which makes him one of Sallinger's targets. Sallinger later kidnaps Erik, who survives only because Jessica and Trish come to his rescue.
stages.whoA: Serial killer he tries to blackmail, who later kidnaps him.
stages.whoB: Man who senses his darkness and tries to blackmail him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik Gelden has the power to sense evil, and he becomes Jessica's love interest. He works with her on the hunt for Gregory Sallinger.
stages.whoA: His love interest, who works with him to hunt Sallinger.
stages.whoB: Her love interest, who senses evil and helps hunt Sallinger.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik Gelden and Jessica bring Erik's sister Brianna to Malcolm for protection, and Erik's power picks up only a little darkness in him. When Jessica later needs help on the Sallinger case, she calls on the two of them together.
stages.whoA: Jessica's partner, who protects his sister and helps on the Sallinger case.
stages.whoB: Man who brings his sister Brianna to him for protection.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik Gelden first helps Trish track down criminals. He turns against her once she starts killing them.
stages.whoA: Vigilante he helps hunt criminals, until she starts killing them.
stages.whoB: Ally who helps her hunt criminals, then turns on her when she kills.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Erik Selvig is Jane Foster's mentor and an old friend of her late father.
stages.whoA: His protégée, whose late father was his old friend.
stages.whoB: Her mentor, and an old friend of her late father.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki takes control of Erik Selvig's mind with his scepter and forces him to build the device that opens the Chitauri portal over New York.
stages.whoA: God who takes over his mind and makes him build the portal device.
stages.whoB: Scientist he enslaves with the scepter to open the Chitauri portal.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Erik Selvig's gravimetric devices help Thor fight Malekith during the Convergence in Greenwich, and they end up sending the Dark Elf's own ship crashing down on him.
stages.whoA: Dark Elf his gravimetric devices help Thor defeat in Greenwich.
stages.whoB: Scientist whose gravimetric devices bring his own ship down on him.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Nick Fury brings Erik Selvig into S.H.I.E.L.D. to study the Tesseract. Selvig is working on it when Loki arrives and takes control of his mind.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who brings him in to study the Tesseract.
stages.whoB: Scientist he brings in to study the Tesseract.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Erik Selvig is suspicious of Thor when Jane finds him in the desert, but he helps him get out of S.H.I.E.L.D. custody and the two bond over drinks.
stages.whoA: God he distrusts at first, then helps escape and bonds with over drinks.
stages.whoB: Jane's mentor, wary at first, who helps him escape S.H.I.E.L.D. They bond over drinks.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Pip the Troll is Eros' companion and friend. He announces Eros when the two arrive on the Domo.
stages.whoA: His companion and friend, who announces him on the Domo.
stages.whoB: His companion and friend, whom he announces on the Domo.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Eros is Thanos's adoptive brother, an Eternal placed with Titan's royal family who later rebels against Arishem and leaves to become an outlaw. Pip introduces him as Thanos's brother when he arrives on the Domo.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson fights Georges Batroc during a hostage rescue over Tunisia. They clash again after Batroc joins the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoA: The Falcon, who fights him over Tunisia and again with the Flag Smashers.
stages.whoB: Mercenary he fights over Tunisia, who later joins the Flag Smashers.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sharon frees Georges Batroc from an Algerian prison and, as the Power Broker, hires him to spy on Karli Morgenthau. When Batroc threatens to expose her, she shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: Power Broker who frees and hires him, then shoots him dead.
stages.whoB: Mercenary she frees and hires, then kills when he threatens to expose her.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Georges Batroc hijacks the S.H.I.E.L.D. ship Lemurian Star, and Steve Rogers leads the rescue. When Batroc taunts him for hiding behind his shield, Steve tosses it aside and beats him hand to hand, though Batroc escapes.
stages.whoA: Captain America, who beats him hand to hand on the Lemurian Star.
stages.whoB: Hijacker of the Lemurian Star, whom he beats without his shield.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Georgi Luchkov thinks he is interrogating Natasha Romanoff, but she is the one interrogating him.
stages.whoA: Spy he thinks he's interrogating, who is really interrogating him.
stages.whoB: Arms dealer who thinks he's interrogating her.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ava Starr, the daughter of Hank's former partner Elihas Starr, needs the quantum energy in Hank's lab to survive, which would ruin his plan to rescue Janet. As Ghost she steals the lab and fights Hank's family until Janet heals her.
stages.whoA: Her father's former partner, whose lab she steals to survive.
stages.whoB: Elihas Starr's daughter, who steals his lab and endangers Janet's rescue.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ghost ambushes Hope for the part she buys from Sonny Burch and later steals Hank's shrunken lab. Hope fights her again and again until the family agrees to help cure her.
stages.whoA: The Wasp, who fights her again and again until the family helps her.
stages.whoB: Thief who ambushes her and steals the lab, until they agree to help.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ghost needs the quantum energy that keeps Janet alive in the Quantum Realm, putting her rescue at risk. After Janet returns, she uses her new quantum powers to heal Ghost for a time.
stages.whoA: Woman whose quantum energy she needs, and who later heals her.
stages.whoB: Woman who needs her quantum energy, whom she heals on her return.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina sends Ghost and John Walker to the O.X.E. vault to kill each other. They survive together and end up as teammates in the New Avengers.
stages.whoA: Sent to the vault to kill her. Now a teammate in the New Avengers.
stages.whoB: Sent to the vault to kill him. Now a teammate in the New Avengers.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: While Sonny Burch has Luis drugged with truth serum, Ghost appears beside him and gets him to reveal that Scott is in Muir Woods.
stages.whoA: Scott's friend, whom she gets to reveal Scott's location under truth serum.
stages.whoB: Masked thief who gets Scott's location out of him under truth serum.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ghost repeatedly tries to steal Hank Pym's lab to cure her condition, and Scott fights her alongside Hope. Once she is at peace with the family, he goes into the Quantum Realm to gather healing particles for her.
stages.whoA: Ant-Man, who fights her, then gathers healing particles for her.
stages.whoB: Thief after Hank's lab, whom he fights, then gathers healing particles for.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ghost and Sonny Burch both try to seize Hank Pym's shrunken lab, which puts them at war.
stages.whoA: Black marketeer she fights for Hank's shrunken lab.
stages.whoB: Rival thief he fights for Hank's shrunken lab.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina sends both Ghost and Taskmaster to the same vault in Utah so they will kill each other. In the fight, Ghost shoots Taskmaster dead.
stages.whoA: Operative sent to kill her in the vault, whom she shoots dead.
stages.whoB: Operative sent to the same vault, who shoots her dead.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina hires Ghost, on the run from fifteen nations, as a shadow operative for O.X.E. Facing impeachment, she sends Ghost and her other operatives to kill each other to bury the evidence, and Ghost turns against her.
stages.whoA: Her boss at O.X.E., who sends her to die, so she turns on her.
stages.whoB: Shadow operative she hires, then sends to die. Ghost turns on her.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina sends Yelena to stop Ghost from stealing from her vault in Utah, and the two fight there alongside Taskmaster. Once they realize Valentina meant for them to kill each other, they band together as the Thunderbolts.
stages.whoA: Sent to stop her in the vault. Now a fellow Thunderbolt.
stages.whoB: Thief she's sent to stop in the vault. Now a fellow Thunderbolt.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera is Gideon Malick's head of security and right-hand man in HYDRA. He helps Malick bring Hive back to Earth, but once Hive's parasites infect him, his loyalty shifts to Hive.
stages.whoA: His head of security, until Hive's parasites steal his loyalty.
stages.whoB: His Hydra boss, until Hive infects him and his loyalty shifts.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick kidnaps Glenn Talbot's son George, hoping to force Talbot into betraying Phil Coulson. It is one of the ways Malick manipulates Talbot as he clears the way for Hive.
stages.whoA: General he manipulates by kidnapping his son George.
stages.whoB: Hydra leader who kidnaps his son to force his betrayal.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Grant Ward rebuilds Hydra and serves Gideon Malick's plan to bring back Hive.
stages.whoA: Hydra rebuilder who serves his plan to bring back Hive.
stages.whoB: His Hydra superior, whose plan to bring back Hive he serves.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick worships Hive and helps bring him back. Hive then turns on him.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman he worships and brings back, who turns on him.
stages.whoB: Worshipper who brings him back to Earth, whom he then turns on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick has Jemma and Fitz captured and brought to his Hydra castle because he wants to know how she made it back from the planet Maveth. The two refuse to help him open the portal to bring Hive to Earth.
stages.whoA: Scientist he has captured to learn how she escaped Maveth.
stages.whoB: Hydra leader who captures her to learn about Maveth.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick has Fitz and Jemma Simmons brought to his Hydra castle to help open the portal to Maveth. Fitz is then sent through the portal with Grant Ward to bring back Hive.
stages.whoA: Scientist he has captured and sends through the portal with Ward.
stages.whoB: Hydra leader who captures him and sends him through the portal to Maveth.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell captures Gideon Malick during the raid on an oil field and wraps him in Overpowering Tape. Lincoln then helps wreck Malick's plan to bring Hive back to Earth.
stages.whoA: Inhuman who captures him and helps wreck his plan for Hive.
stages.whoB: Hydra leader he captures in the oil field raid.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Gideon Malick sits on the World Security Council that oversees Nick Fury's S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Director his World Security Council oversees.
stages.whoB: World Security Council member who oversees his S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick secretly leads HYDRA, and when Phil Coulson comes to him about it, Malick warns him not to get ahead of himself. After Malick's HYDRA kills Coulson's lover Rosalind Price, Coulson hunts him down.
stages.whoA: Director who hunts him after Hydra kills Rosalind.
stages.whoB: Secret Hydra head whose people kill Rosalind, so he hunts him down.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick has advised Rosalind Price since her days at NASA, and he arranges for the ATCU to replace S.H.I.E.L.D. with her in charge, steering her from the shadows. She only learns he is Hydra when she and Phil Coulson work it out together.
stages.whoA: His protégée, whom he secretly steers as head of the ATCU.
stages.whoB: Her longtime adviser, secretly Hydra, who steers her ATCU.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Karun Patel travels with Gilgamesh and the Eternals, and holds a funeral for him after Kro kills him.
stages.whoA: Kingo's valet, who travels with him and holds his funeral.
stages.whoB: Eternal he travels with, and gives a funeral after Kro kills him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Kro, the leader of the Deviants, kills Gilgamesh in the Amazon and takes his power.
stages.whoA: Deviant leader who kills him and takes his power.
stages.whoB: Eternal he kills in the Amazon to take his power.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi and Ikaris reunite with Gilgamesh in the Australian outback when they gather the Eternals after Ajak's death.
stages.whoA: Fellow Eternal who finds him in the outback after Ajak's death.
stages.whoB: Fellow Eternal she reunites with in the Australian outback.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite uses her illusions to show the people of Mesopotamia Gilgamesh's feats, helping turn him into a legend. The two fight the Deviants side by side as Eternals for thousands of years.
stages.whoA: Fellow Eternal whose illusions make him a legend in Mesopotamia.
stages.whoB: Fellow Eternal whose feats she turns into legend with her illusions.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Gilgamesh is Thena's closest friend and partner. He cares for her for centuries as she suffers from Mahd Wy'ry.
stages.whoA: His closest friend and partner, whom he cares for through Mahd Wy'ry.
stages.whoB: Her closest friend and partner, who cares for her through Mahd Wy'ry.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica employs Gillian as an assistant at Alias Investigations. Gillian keeps the office running and keeps tabs on Jessica's clients.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Alias Investigations.
stages.whoB: Her assistant, who keeps the office running and tabs on clients.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gillian, who works at Alias Investigations, refuses to hand Malcolm Jessica's files on Sallinger until Trish gives him permission. The two then wait together for Jessica and help her track Sallinger's next target.
stages.whoA: Jessica's partner, whom she keeps from the files, then helps.
stages.whoB: Alias assistant who guards Jessica's files, then helps him track Sallinger.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera serves Gideon Malick and turns on Grant Ward when Malick decides Ward is no longer useful.
stages.whoA: Hydra leader he turns on when Malick drops him.
stages.whoB: Malick's enforcer, who turns on him once Malick is done with him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera and Hellfire serve Hive together and seize a missile silo for his plan to spread Terrigen across the Earth. When Hive starts to break down, Hellfire questions his sanity while Giyera stays fiercely loyal.
stages.whoA: Fellow servant of Hive, who questions him as Giyera stays loyal.
stages.whoB: Fellow servant of Hive, fiercely loyal while he has doubts.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera serves HYDRA under Gideon Malick, but once Hive's parasites infect him, his loyalty shifts to Hive. He tends to Hive as the Inhuman recovers and learns about the modern world.
stages.whoA: His new master, once Hive's parasites infect him.
stages.whoB: Malick's man, whom he infects and wins over.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera hunts Lance Hunter and Bobbi Morse when they break into Endotex Labs. He uses his telekinesis to turn their own guns against them, leaving Hunter longing for the days when they didn't have to fight aliens.
stages.whoA: Agent he hunts at Endotex Labs, turning his own gun on him.
stages.whoB: Telekinetic who turns his own gun on him at Endotex Labs.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera, Gideon Malick's telekinetic enforcer, kidnaps Fitz and Jemma Simmons and brings them to Hydra's castle. Later, aboard Zephyr One, Fitz outwits him and kills him with a cloaked gun.
stages.whoA: Scientist he kidnaps, who later kills him with a cloaked gun.
stages.whoB: Malick's enforcer, who kidnaps him and whom he kills with a cloaked gun.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Hale captures and tortures Glenn Talbot and turns him toward Hydra's plans. As Graviton, Talbot kills her.
stages.whoA: Hydra general who tortures and turns him. As Graviton, he kills her.
stages.whoB: General she captures and turns toward Hydra, who kills her as Graviton.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Isabelle Hartley and Lance Hunter pose as Air Force soldiers during Carl Creel's attack on Glenn Talbot, pulling him to cover and then taking him captive for Coulson's team. After Hartley is killed, Talbot offers Hunter a proper funeral for her in exchange for betraying Coulson.
stages.whoA: Agent who saves him from Creel, then takes him captive.
stages.whoB: General she pulls to cover, then takes captive for Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Glenn Talbot works closely with Director Jeffrey Mace and supplies the serum behind Mace's powers.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. director he works with closely and supplies serum to.
stages.whoB: Close ally who supplies the serum behind his powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Glenn Talbot works with Jemma and the team at the Lighthouse until his obsession with Gravitonium takes over. He shoots her with an I.C.E.R. so he can climb into the Particle Infusion Chamber and take its power for himself.
stages.whoA: Scientist he works with, then shoots with an I.C.E.R. to seize Gravitonium.
stages.whoB: General who works with the team, then I.C.E.R.s her for Gravitonium.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Disguised as an Air Force officer, Lance Hunter helps kidnap General Glenn Talbot while protecting him from Carl Creel. Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, later tries to bribe him into betraying Coulson in exchange for a proper funeral for Isabelle Hartley.
stages.whoA: Mercenary who kidnaps him, whom he later tries to bribe.
stages.whoB: General he kidnaps, who later tries to bribe him to betray Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Glenn Talbot starts out hunting Coulson's team, then grudgingly works beside Fitz against threats like Hive.
stages.whoA: Agent he hunts at first, then grudgingly works beside.
stages.whoB: General who hunts the team, then grudgingly works beside him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: After Talbot gives himself Gravitonium powers, his attack on the team leaves Fitz buried under rubble and dying.
stages.whoA: Agent his Graviton attack leaves dying under rubble.
stages.whoB: Graviton, whose attack leaves him buried and dying.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: While guarding Coulson at his meeting with Glenn Talbot, Lincoln nearly kills Carl Creel, believing Creel is attacking Talbot, before learning Creel is Talbot's bodyguard. Later Lincoln tells Talbot he believes Lash's purpose is to kill Hive.
stages.whoA: Inhuman who nearly kills his bodyguard, then tells him about Lash.
stages.whoB: General whose bodyguard he nearly kills, and whom he tells about Lash.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Maria Hill leads Glenn Talbot to Coulson's hidden base at Providence and urges Coulson to hand it over. When Coulson refuses, she switches sides and helps fight off Talbot's soldiers.
stages.whoA: Former S.H.I.E.L.D. deputy who leads him to Providence, then switches sides.
stages.whoB: General she leads to Providence, then fights off when Coulson refuses.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Melinda May saves General Glenn Talbot from Carl Creel and then helps kidnap him so Coulson can deal with him.
stages.whoA: Agent who saves him from Creel, then helps kidnap him.
stages.whoB: General she saves from Creel, then helps kidnap for Coulson.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Talbot infuses himself with Gravitonium and becomes a threat to the whole planet, and May's team has to stop him.
stages.whoA: Agent whose team has to stop him after Gravitonium.
stages.whoB: Graviton, a threat to the planet whom her team must stop.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: General Glenn Talbot hunts Phil Coulson and what is left of S.H.I.E.L.D., convinced they are a terrorist group.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. leader he hunts as a terrorist.
stages.whoB: General who hunts him, convinced S.H.I.E.L.D. is a terrorist group.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: After years of chasing each other, Talbot and Coulson start working together and become uneasy friends.
stages.whoA: Uneasy friend, after years of chasing each other.
stages.whoB: Uneasy friend, after years of chasing each other.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: After Talbot absorbs Gravitonium and becomes Graviton, he turns on Coulson.
stages.whoA: Old friend he turns on as Graviton.
stages.whoB: Old friend who turns on him as Graviton.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Glenn Talbot appears in young Robin Hinton's visions, and under Hydra's brainwashing he attacks her mother and tries to take her for General Hale. Later, as Graviton, he kidnaps Robin and her mother Polly and takes them to Qovas' ship, promising to win Robin over.
stages.whoA: Girl he hunts for Hale and later kidnaps as Graviton.
stages.whoB: Man from her visions, who hunts her for Hale and later kidnaps her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: After Glenn Talbot is shot in the head, R. Hale kidnaps him, and her daughter Ruby tortures him for months to bend him to HYDRA's will. Through it all he insists that Coulson will come to rescue him.
stages.whoA: Hale's daughter, who tortures him for months to bend him.
stages.whoB: General she tortures for months, who insists Coulson will save him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi uses a Photostatic Veil to pose as Glenn Talbot and trick Coulson's team. Once Bakshi is caught, Coulson hands him over to Talbot, whose base he is later kidnapped from.
stages.whoA: Hydra agent who impersonates him, then is kidnapped from his base.
stages.whoB: General he impersonates, and from whose base he is taken.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Goose is Mar-Vell's pet Flerken and comes with her to Earth when she goes undercover as Dr. Wendy Lawson.
stages.whoA: Owner who brings Goose to Earth when she goes undercover.
stages.whoB: Her pet Flerken, who comes with her to Earth.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Goose is the Flerken who wins Nick Fury over in 1995 and scratches out his eye.
stages.whoA: Agent Goose wins over in 1995, then scratches out his eye.
stages.whoB: The Flerken who wins him over, then scratches out his eye.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gordon identifies James as a descendant of Inhumans and brings him into Afterlife. Long after James is cast out, he admits he always assumed Jiaying would send Gordon to come for him.
stages.whoA: Inhuman descendant he brings into Afterlife.
stages.whoB: Teleporter who brings him into Afterlife.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying guides Gordon through his Terrigenesis when he loses his eyes, and he becomes her loyal right-hand man at Afterlife. He stands by her even when she tricks their people into a war with S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: His leader at Afterlife, who guides him through Terrigenesis.
stages.whoB: Her loyal right-hand man, whom she guided through Terrigenesis.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon, the eyeless Inhuman teleporter who serves Jiaying, fights S.H.I.E.L.D. aboard the Iliad. Fitz rigs his field generators to block Gordon's teleporting and then kills him in the fight.
stages.whoA: Agent who blocks his teleporting and kills him on the Iliad.
stages.whoB: Jiaying's teleporter, whom he kills aboard the Iliad.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon watches over Lincoln Campbell and saves him and his girlfriend from a car crash, then brings him to Afterlife. Lincoln trusts Gordon as the community's only link to the outside world, and they stand together until Jiaying's war on S.H.I.E.L.D. drives them apart.
stages.whoA: Inhuman he saves and brings to Afterlife, until Jiaying's war splits them.
stages.whoB: Teleporter who saves him and brings him to Afterlife. They split over Jiaying's war.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Gordon brings Raina into Afterlife and helps her cope with her new form.
stages.whoA: New Inhuman he brings to Afterlife and helps adjust.
stages.whoB: Teleporter who brings her to Afterlife and helps her cope.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Jane Foster fights Gorr as the Mighty Thor. Her plea helps him choose love over revenge.
stages.whoA: The Mighty Thor, whose plea helps him choose love over revenge.
stages.whoB: God Butcher she fights, who chooses love after her plea.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Love is Gorr's daughter. Her death by starvation drives him to hunt the gods, and his dying wish to Eternity brings her back.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whose death drives him and whom he brings back.
stages.whoB: Her father, whose dying wish brings her back to life.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Gorr the God Butcher attacks Sif while hunting gods, and she loses an arm in the fight. She sends out a distress call that brings Thor to her.
stages.whoA: Asgardian warrior he maims while hunting gods.
stages.whoB: God Butcher who costs her an arm.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Gorr hunts gods and kidnaps Asgard's children, which brings him into battle with Thor. In the end Thor persuades him to bring back his daughter instead.
stages.whoA: God of Thunder who fights him and persuades him to save his daughter.
stages.whoB: God Butcher who kidnaps Asgard's children. He persuades him to choose his daughter.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Gorr badly wounds Valkyrie in the Shadow Realm while she tries to rescue the children.
stages.whoA: Asgard's king, whom he badly wounds in the Shadow Realm.
stages.whoB: God Butcher who badly wounds her in the Shadow Realm.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: After Grant Ward's death, Hive takes over his body and uses it as a host.
stages.whoA: Inhuman who takes over his dead body as a host.
stages.whoB: Dead agent whose body he takes over.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Grant Ward and Ian Quinn work together for John Garrett's Hydra cell. Earlier, while still undercover on Coulson's team, Ward helps raid Quinn's mansion.
stages.whoA: Hydra ally whose mansion he raided while undercover.
stages.whoB: Fellow Garrett operative, who once raided his mansion undercover.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Grant Ward fights Jakob Nystrom for the Berserker Staff after Nystrom stabs Elliot Randolph with a piece of it. Ward beats him, though the staff's rage lingers in him afterward.
stages.whoA: Thieves he fights for the Berserker Staff.
stages.whoB: Agent who beats Jakob for the Berserker Staff.
