stages.text: Grant Ward is Jemma's friend and teammate on Coulson's team.
stages.whoA: Friend and teammate on Coulson's team.
stages.whoB: Friend and teammate on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Once Ward is revealed as Hydra, he drops Jemma and Fitz into the ocean in a sealed box.
stages.whoA: Former friend he drops into the ocean in a sealed box.
stages.whoB: Hydra traitor who drops her and Fitz into the ocean.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jemma later tries to kill Ward for what he has done to Fitz.
stages.whoA: Former friend who tries to kill him for what he did to Fitz.
stages.whoB: Hydra traitor she tries to kill for what he did to Fitz.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: John Garrett found teenage Grant Ward in juvenile detention and trained him in the woods to be his loyal soldier. Ward follows him into Hydra and treats him like a father.
stages.whoA: His mentor and father figure, who trained him in the woods.
stages.whoB: His loyal soldier, whom he trained from a teenager.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Grant Ward and Kara Palamas become lovers and partners in crime. He accidentally kills her.
stages.whoA: His lover and partner in crime, whom he accidentally kills.
stages.whoB: Her lover and partner in crime, who accidentally kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Kebo becomes Grant Ward's right-hand man as Ward rebuilds HYDRA after its old cells collapse. He bluntly tells Ward the organization has disintegrated and helps him gather new recruits.
stages.whoA: His right-hand man as he rebuilds Hydra.
stages.whoB: His boss, who rebuilds Hydra with his help.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lance Hunter and Grant Ward become sworn enemies after Ward tortures Bobbi Morse.
stages.whoA: Sworn enemy after he tortures Bobbi.
stages.whoB: Sworn enemy who tortured Bobbi.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Grant Ward and Leo Fitz are teammates and friends on Coulson's team.

stages.text: Piper joins the strike team sent to kill Hive and blasts a hole in him with a grenade launcher, but he heals in moments.
stages.whoA: Agent who blasts a hole in him, which heals in moments.
stages.whoB: Inhuman she blasts with a grenade launcher, who heals instantly.

stages.text: Hive kills Will Daniels on the planet Maveth and wears his body, which haunts Jemma Simmons.
stages.whoA: Astronaut he kills on Maveth and wears.
stages.whoB: Inhuman who kills him on Maveth and wears his body.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Raza holds Ho Yinsen prisoner with Tony Stark in the Ten Rings' cave and threatens his life to force their work. Yinsen is killed by Raza's men while buying Tony time to escape.
stages.whoA: Ten Rings captor whose men kill him.
stages.whoB: Prisoner he threatens to force their work.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Ho Yinsen is held prisoner with Tony Stark and saves his life with an electromagnet. He sacrifices himself so Tony can escape.
stages.whoA: Fellow prisoner whose life he saves and for whom he dies.
stages.whoB: Fellow prisoner who saves his life and sacrifices himself for his escape.

stages.text: Holden Holliway hires Jennifer to lead GLK&H's new superhuman law division, as long as she works as She-Hulk.
stages.whoA: Lawyer he hires to lead superhuman law, as long as she's She-Hulk.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who hires her to lead the superhuman law division.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Director Jeffrey Mace brings Holden Radcliffe in as a consultant, briefing him on Eli Morrow and handing him strange boxes that draw energy from the multiverse. Mace also lets Jemma Simmons take Melinda May to Radcliffe to save her life.
stages.whoA: Director who brings him in as a consultant.
stages.whoB: Scientist he brings in to consult.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jemma Simmons works with Holden Radcliffe to save Melinda May's life, though she distrusts his android Aida. When he betrays S.H.I.E.L.D. and traps her friends in the Framework, Jemma goes in after them and confronts him there.
stages.whoA: Scientist who works with him, then confronts him in the Framework.
stages.whoB: Scientist she works with, who betrays S.H.I.E.L.D. and traps her friends.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe befriends Fitz, and the two secretly build the android Aida and the first new Life Model Decoys together. Radcliffe then turns on him, kidnapping Fitz and trapping his mind in the Framework, where Fitz becomes the cruel Doctor.
stages.whoA: Friend he builds Aida with, then kidnaps and traps in the Framework.
stages.whoB: Friend he builds Aida with, who then traps his mind in the Framework.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: May rescues Holden Radcliffe from Hive's missile silo.
stages.whoA: Agent who rescues him from Hive's silo.
stages.whoB: Scientist she rescues from Hive's missile silo.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Radcliffe helps Jemma Simmons save May's life after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. Then he secretly replaces May with a Life Model Decoy and uses it to steal the Darkhold.
stages.whoA: Agent he saves, then secretly replaces with an L.M.D.
stages.whoB: Scientist who saves her life, then swaps her for an L.M.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe helps Phil Coulson's team before his own plans with Aida take over.
stages.whoA: Director he helps, before his plans with Aida take over.
stages.whoB: Scientist who helps his team before turning to his own plans.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe teams up with the Superior, Anton Ivanov, to find the Darkhold. He offers to get inside Billy Koenig's head and uses the Framework to pull the book's location from his memories.
stages.whoA: Partner in the hunt for the Darkhold.
stages.whoB: Scientist he teams with to find the Darkhold.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe and Tucker Shockley work together for the Superior on the Watchdogs' submarine. Shockley throws Billy Koenig into a cell with Radcliffe, who poses as a fellow prisoner to win Koenig's trust.
stages.whoA: Fellow servant of the Superior on the Watchdogs' sub.
stages.whoB: Fellow servant of the Superior, who poses as Koenig's cellmate.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri becomes Hope Shlottman's attorney after Hope is jailed for a murder Kilgrave forced on her.
stages.whoA: Her attorney after Kilgrave forces her to kill.
stages.whoB: Client jailed for a murder Kilgrave forced on her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Hope's parents hire Jessica to find their missing daughter, and Jessica rescues her from Kilgrave. When Hope is jailed for the killings Kilgrave forced on her, Jessica fights to prove her innocence.
stages.whoA: Investigator who rescues her and fights to prove her innocence.
stages.whoB: Missing girl she rescues and fights to clear.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave holds Hope under his control, rapes her, and forces her to kill her parents. Later Hope takes her own life so that Jessica will be free to stop him.
stages.whoA: Her abuser, who forces her to kill her parents.
stages.whoB: Girl he controls, rapes and forces to kill her parents.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Trish Walker interviews Hope on her radio show to help clear her name.
stages.whoA: Radio host who interviews her to clear her name.
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's victim, whom she interviews on air to clear her name.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Janet van Dyne is Hope van Dyne's mother, lost when Hope was a child, and Hope grows up without her.
stages.whoA: Her mother, lost when she was a child.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, who grows up without her.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Hope helps bring her mother home from the Quantum Realm.
stages.whoA: Her mother, whom she helps bring home.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, who helps bring her home.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Jimmy Woo leads the FBI's search for Hope and her father after they go on the run for helping Scott break the Sokovia Accords.
stages.whoA: FBI agent who leads the search for her and her father.
stages.whoB: Fugitive he hunts along with her father.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Hope van Dyne learns about Kang the Conqueror from her mother when her family is trapped in the Quantum Realm. She fights him at his citadel, and she and Scott Lang defeat him in the final battle over his Multiversal Engine.
stages.whoA: Conqueror her mother warns of, whom she helps defeat.
stages.whoB: The Wasp, who fights him and helps defeat him.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox guards Sonny Burch during his deal with Hope van Dyne. When she attacks in her Wasp suit, he tries to shoot her, but she knocks him down.
stages.whoA: Burch's guard, who tries to shoot her before she drops him.
stages.whoB: The Wasp, who knocks him down when he tries to shoot her.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Hope van Dyne trains Scott Lang to be Ant-Man, and the two fall for each other.
stages.whoA: The man she trains as Ant-Man, and falls for.
stages.whoB: Trainer who makes him Ant-Man, and whom he falls for.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: After Scott's trip to Germany costs him her trust, they make up and fight together as Ant-Man and the Wasp.
stages.whoA: Partner who lost her trust, now fighting beside her as Ant-Man.
stages.whoB: Partner whose trust he wins back. They fight as Ant-Man and the Wasp.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Sonny Burch sells Hope black market parts for the Quantum Tunnel under her alias. Once he learns who she really is, he tries to blackmail her and steal Hank's lab for himself.
stages.whoA: Black marketeer who tries to blackmail her and steal the lab.
stages.whoB: Buyer he blackmails once he learns who she is.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: When Uzman flees with the quantum part during Hope van Dyne's fight at Sonny Burch's restaurant, she chases him into the kitchen and knocks him out with an enlarged salt shaker.
stages.whoA: Burch's man, whom she knocks out with a salt shaker.
stages.whoB: The Wasp, who knocks him out with a giant salt shaker.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Ivan Vanko blames Howard Stark for disgracing his father, Anton Vanko, and wants revenge on the Stark family.
stages.whoA: Anton Vanko's son, who wants revenge on the Starks.
stages.whoB: The man he blames for disgracing his father.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jack Thompson leads the SSR manhunt for Howard Stark when Howard is accused of selling his weapons. Once Howard is cleared, he makes Jack heap praise on him at a press conference, much to Jack's annoyance.
stages.whoA: SSR agent who hunts him, then must praise him in public.
stages.whoB: Fugitive he hunts, who later makes him heap praise on him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Howard Stark takes in Jason Wilkes while Zero Matter leaves him trapped and invisible, and the two scientists work together to cure him. They later team up to open a rift that will draw Whitney Frost out.
stages.whoA: Fellow scientist he takes in and works to cure.
stages.whoB: Fellow scientist who takes him in and works to cure him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff blames Howard Stark for a massacre and hypnotizes him, sending him to drop a deadly gas over New York.
stages.whoA: Leviathan hypnotist who sends him to gas New York.
stages.whoB: Man he blames for a massacre and hypnotizes.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Joseph Manfredi and Howard Stark were childhood friends on the Lower East Side.
stages.whoA: Childhood friend from the Lower East Side.
stages.whoB: Childhood friend from the Lower East Side.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Maria Stark is Howard Stark's wife and the mother of Tony Stark. The Winter Soldier kills them both in 1991.
stages.whoA: His wife, and Tony's mother.
stages.whoB: Her husband, and Tony's father.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Mitchell Carson works with Howard Stark at S.H.I.E.L.D. on a secret attempt to copy Hank Pym's Pym Particles. When Pym finds out and quits in 1989, Carson urges Howard not to let him leave.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague in the plan to copy Pym Particles.
stages.whoB: S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague he urges not to let Pym leave.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is Howard Stark's granddaughter, born to his son Tony and Pepper Potts long after Howard's death.
stages.whoA: His granddaughter, born long after his death.
stages.whoB: Her grandfather, who died long before she was born.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane is Howard Stark's old friend and business partner, and he helps run Stark Industries with him. After Howard dies, Obadiah stays on to guide Howard's son Tony.
stages.whoA: Old friend and business partner at Stark Industries.
stages.whoB: Old friend and partner, whose son he guides after his death.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Howard Stark and Peggy Carter become close friends during the war.
stages.whoA: Close friend from the war.
stages.whoB: Close friend from the war.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After the war, Peggy works in secret to clear Howard's name when he is accused of selling his weapons.
stages.whoA: Close friend who works in secret to clear his name.
stages.whoB: Close friend whose name she works in secret to clear.

stages.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
stages.text: Together Howard and Peggy go on to found S.H.I.E.L.D., and Howard names her its head.
stages.whoA: Fellow founder of S.H.I.E.L.D., whom he names its head.
stages.whoB: Fellow founder of S.H.I.E.L.D., who names her its head.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley runs the SSR's hunt for Howard Stark and blames him for the deaths of his agents. Dooley digs into Howard's past at the Battle of Finow, but Fennhoff kills him before Howard is cleared.
stages.whoA: SSR chief who blames him for his agents' deaths.
stages.whoB: Fugitive he blames for his agents' deaths.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Howard Stark helps turn Steve Rogers into Captain America, flies him behind enemy lines and gives him his vibranium shield. After Steve goes into the ice, Howard spends years searching for him.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whom he outfits and spends years searching for.
stages.whoB: Friend who makes him Cap, gives him his shield, and searches for him.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Howard Stark is Tony Stark's father, and they are distant while Howard is alive. Through an old film Howard left behind, Tony learns how much his father loved him.
stages.whoA: His son, distant while he lives, who learns how loved he was.
stages.whoB: His father, distant in life, whose old recording reveals his love.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Traveling back to 1970, Tony meets his father before he is born and makes peace with him.
stages.whoA: His son, who meets him in 1970 and makes peace.
stages.whoB: His father, whom he meets in 1970 and makes peace with.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Howard Stark comes to Los Angeles to help Peggy Carter stop Whitney Frost and her Zero Matter. In the final fight, Howard and Edwin Jarvis run Frost down with a car.
stages.whoA: Zero Matter villain he runs down with a car.
stages.whoB: Inventor who runs her down with a car alongside Jarvis.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Howard the Duck is one of the living exhibits in the Collector's museum on Knowhere. After the museum is wrecked, the two sit together among the ruins.
stages.whoA: His captor, in whose museum he is a living exhibit.
stages.whoB: Living exhibit in his museum, sitting with him among the ruins.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 is C-20's fellow Hunter at the TVA. When the Variant ambushes C-20's unit in 1985 Oshkosh, B-15 leads the team sent after them.
stages.whoA: Fellow Hunter, whose ambushed unit she leads the team after.
stages.whoB: Fellow Hunter, who leads the team after her ambushed unit.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 helps Mobius and Loki catch Hunter X-5 after he deserts the TVA to live as the actor Brad Wolfe, posing as a fan wanting his autograph so she can grab his TemPad. Back at the TVA, she locks him in holding until he talks about Sylvie.
stages.whoA: Deserter turned actor she helps catch and lock up.
stages.whoB: Fellow Hunter who catches him by posing as a fan.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 arrests Loki for the TVA and has no patience for him at first. After learning the TVA's agents are variants, she helps Loki and Sylvie and fights with him to save the timeline.
stages.whoA: Variant she arrests, then fights beside to save the timeline.
stages.whoB: Hunter who arrests him, then helps him and Sylvie.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 and Mobius are longtime TVA colleagues who clash over his decision to trust Loki.
stages.whoA: Longtime colleague she clashes with over trusting Loki.
stages.whoB: Longtime colleague who clashes with him over trusting Loki.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Once B-15 learns the TVA's agents are stolen variants, she and Mobius work side by side to steer the agency toward protecting the new branches.
stages.whoA: Friend she works beside to protect the new branches.
stages.whoB: Friend who works beside him to protect the new branches.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Hunter B-15 is Mr. Paradox's superior at the TVA, and she shuts down his scheme.
stages.whoA: TVA agent under her, whose scheme she shuts down.
stages.whoB: His superior at the TVA, who shuts down his scheme.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 works with Ouroboros to keep the failing Temporal Loom running, and brings Casey in to help when the blast doors will not open.
stages.whoA: Technician she works with to keep the Loom running.
stages.whoB: Hunter who works with him to keep the Loom running.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 serves Judge Ravonna Renslayer loyally and even shields her from Sylvie. After Sylvie unlocks B-15's memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer, who has her taken into custody and interrogated as a traitor.
stages.whoA: Judge she serves loyally, then turns against.
stages.whoB: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom she has interrogated.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Sylvie enchants Hunter B-15 at the Roxxcart, and the spell stirs memories of the life B-15 had before the TVA. B-15 later asks Sylvie to show her more, then turns on the TVA and frees Sylvie and Loki in front of Renslayer.
stages.whoA: Variant whose enchantment stirs her memories, and whom she frees.
stages.whoB: Hunter she enchants, who later frees her and Loki.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 spots Victor Timely wandering the TVA and recognizes him as a variant of He Who Remains. She stands with Loki and Mobius as they convince him to help save the failing Temporal Loom.
stages.whoA: He Who Remains' variant, whom she helps convince to save the Loom.
stages.whoB: Hunter who recognizes him and helps convince him to save the Loom.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Mobius M. Mobius finds C-20 traumatized in the back of a Roxxcart superstore. He questions her about the Variant who took her.
stages.whoA: Agent who finds her traumatized and questions her.
stages.whoB: Traumatized Hunter he finds and questions.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer is C-20's superior at the TVA. After Sylvie's enchantment leaves C-20 broken, Renslayer interrogates her, and C-20 dies in TVA custody.
stages.whoA: Her superior, who interrogates her before she dies in custody.
stages.whoB: Hunter she interrogates, who dies in TVA custody.
